Recruitment Overview

Unlock teaching opportunities in Uttar Pradesh with the UPTET 2026 exam. The Uttar Pradesh Education Service Selection Commission (UPESSC) has announced the exam schedule, inviting aspirants to apply online from March 27, 2026, to May 3, 2026. Before applying, candidates should review the UPTET 2026 information brochure, which outlines key details such as syllabus, eligibility criteria, age limits, fees, and exam levels for primary and junior teachers.
